id: 18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 带把手机型气动组件的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K10: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
points.K16: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带前后把手的激光焊接机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with front and back handles and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，换另一款焊机的气动组件。
overlay: 带把手机型气动组件的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：把手、右侧盖、气动组件、左侧盖
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a machine handle, a side cover, an air valve block and a second side cover. No people.
shots.narration: 拆把手侧盖、换组件、装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下焊枪开关，焊枪没有出气，他皱眉看着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the trigger of the welding gun but no gas flows, and he frowns at it.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊枪不出气了。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和装着新组件的盒子走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over carrying a toolbox and a boxed new air valve assembly.
shots.narration: 专业技术人员老李来换气动组件。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看具体步骤。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 拆机维修，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能残留高压，至少等5分钟再碰。

shots.scene: 警示卡上一副绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with a yellow and black striped border showing an insulated glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手和一个带蓝色气管的新气动组件
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, a hex key and a new air valve assembly with a solenoid, a small sensor and blue tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 3和5毫米十字刀、5毫米内六角、新组件。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下背面所有线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs all cables from the back.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角松开前后把手的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens the screws of the front and back handles with a hex key.
shots.narration: 用5毫米内六角，松开把手8颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆右侧盖螺钉，从挂架取下焊枪，线缆在台面盘成大圈
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the right cover screws, lifts the welding gun off its holder and lays the cable in wide loops on the bench.
shots.narration: 取下焊枪，线缆盘大圈不急弯。

shots.section_title: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
shots.scene: 老李拆下挂架和线缆夹的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws of the gun holder and the cable clamp.
shots.narration: 拆挂架3颗、线缆夹2颗螺钉。
overlay: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖

shots.section_title: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
shots.scene: 右侧盖向上抬起取下，露出黄色光纤
shots.prompt_en: The right cover is lifted upward and off, revealing a yellow fiber cable looped inside.
shots.narration: 把右侧盖向上抬下来。

shots.scene: 台面上铺泡沫，老李把机器侧放上去
shots.prompt_en: A foam pad is placed on the bench and the facility engineer lays the machine on its side on top of it.
shots.narration: 机器侧放，左侧下面垫泡沫。

shots.scene: 老李拆下机器底部的两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes two screws from the bottom of the machine.
shots.narration: 用5毫米十字刀拆底部2颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 细十字刀松开固定黄色光纤的小夹子
shots.prompt_en: A fine cross-head screwdriver loosens the two screws of a small clamp holding the yellow fiber.
shots.narration: 用2.5毫米十字刀松光纤夹2颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 手指按下快插接头的释放环，拔出气管
shots.prompt_en: Fingers press the release ring of a push-fit air fitting and pull the tube out.
shots.narration: 按下释放环，拔出两根气管。

shots.scene: 老李小心把机器扶正
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carefully stands the machine upright again.
shots.narration: 再小心把机器扶正。

shots.scene: 机内黄色光纤顺着原来的大弧度盘着
shots.prompt_en: Inside the machine, the yellow fiber stays in its original wide curve. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色光纤别弯折，保持原来的弧度。

shots.section_title: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线
shots.scene: 老李拆左侧盖螺钉，从主板拔下两根线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the left cover screw and unplugs two cables from the main board.
shots.narration: 3毫米十字刀拆左盖螺钉，拔两根线。
overlay: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线

shots.scene: 老李把旧气动组件整个取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the whole old air valve assembly out of the machine.
shots.narration: 把整个旧组件取出来。

shots.scene: 新组件的两根线从右侧穿到左侧，插回主板
shots.prompt_en: The two cables of the new air valve assembly are fed from the right side to the left side and plugged into the main board.
shots.narration: 新组件两根线右穿左，接回主板。

shots.scene: 左侧盖两边挂钩对准机架销钉推入，拧紧螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The hooks on both sides of the left cover are aligned with pegs on the frame, the cover is pushed in and its screw is tightened.
shots.narration: 左侧盖挂钩对销钉推入，拧紧。

shots.scene: 两根蓝色气管插回接头
shots.prompt_en: Two blue air tubes are pushed back into their fittings.
shots.narration: 接回两根气管。

shots.scene: 光纤夹拧紧，气管卡好
shots.prompt_en: The fiber clamp is tightened and the air tubes are clipped in place.
shots.narration: 把光纤和气管固定到位。

shots.scene: 机器再次侧放在泡沫上，装回底部两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The machine is laid on the foam again and the two bottom screws are refitted.
shots.narration: 侧放装回底部2颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 右侧盖装回，线缆夹、挂架拧紧，焊枪挂回
shots.prompt_en: The right cover is refitted, the cable clamp and gun holder are screwed in place, and the welding gun is hung back.
shots.narration: 装右侧盖，线缆夹2颗、挂架3颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 侧盖螺钉装回
shots.prompt_en: The screw on the right cover is refitted.
shots.narration: 焊枪归位，装好侧盖螺钉。

shots.scene: 把手装回，内六角拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The front and back handles are refitted and tightened with a hex key.
shots.narration: 装回前后把手。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a warning card, a foam pad, an air valve block and a yellow fiber loop.
shots.narration: 专业人员操作，侧放垫泡沫，换组件。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 线缆不急弯，光纤保持原弧度。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手，焊枪挂在挂架上
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the machine with its gun hung on the holder.
shots.narration: 气动组件换好了，下次见！
